description: Specify thermal rigid block group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. By default, s is assigned to the group slot Default. Use the remove keyword to remove s from all slots.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot slot to s. By default, slot Default is used.

examples.description: Assign the group in the Default slot
Assign the group in a named slot

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): rblock.thermal.isgroup reads True after assignment to the Default and a named slot, and False again after remove, on all six consoles.
notes: The manuals list an 'add' keyword (assign s to the next available slot). The engine rejects it with 'Unused extra parameter' on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8, after it has already assigned s to slot Default. Use 'slot <s2>' to pick another slot.
